description:
Land Aquisition - Malippota, Bibile D/S Division, Monaragala District Sec. 38 (a) 
Land Aquisition -Correction Paper
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific land descriptions, boundaries, and ownership details. It contains orders for taking possession of land and corrections to land names, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government personnel or structural changes.
